state.headline: stav zatím nelze spolehlivě určit
reasons: Copernicus 1 km dává smíšený půdně-vlhkostní signál

method_note: Operational local drought signal: P-ET0 water balance + reanalysis soil-moisture percentiles + Sentinel-2 NDMI + independent Copernicus CLMS 1 km SSM/SWI control. It is not an official drought classification.
known_limitations: Reanalysis soil moisture is coarser than the local terrain; Sentinel and the reviewed landscape network provide the local spatial refinement.
The first-year percentile is an operational baseline, not yet a long-term local climatology.
Copernicus SSM/SWI has 1 km resolution; it strengthens independent validation but cannot by itself resolve field-scale differences inside Nové Hraběcí.

copernicus_1km.note: CLMS 1 km satellite control; kept as independent evidence and does not change the warning rank until a local archive is calibrated.
